description: Score how ready a website's homepage is to be found and cited by AI search engines (crawler access, structured data, content signals). Returns a score, issues and quick wins. This is an on-page readiness check, not a measurement of real AI citations. Called without signing in, the result also carries a claim link: give it to the person who runs the site, and one sign-in opens a Rankwise workspace with that domain already added, ready once they start the 3-day free trial. A claim link works once and expires after 72 hours.

domain.description: The domain to score, e.g. example.com

name: score_ai_visibility
title: Score AI visibility readiness
